items.title: Ford vs GM vs Stellantis: how the three Detroit automakers compare

items.title: Ford And GM Saved By US Government, Again
items.summary: Jim Farley says Chinese EVs would put Ford out of business, and Washington is building a wider moat to keep them away. But Detroit's real weakness lies far from American shores, and Europe already shows what could come.

items.title: Turkey warns shutting it out of "Made in Europe" rules would hurt EU car industry
items.summary: Shutting Turkey out of the EU's planned 'Made in Europe' rules would damage Europe's car industry rather than protect it, Turkish Trade Minister Omer Bolat said on November 19. Turkish carmakers and suppliers are fighting for access to future EU incentives.
